lead_raw_text:
The structure of Th9Mg3Pt9 (reduced formula Th3MgPt3) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 21 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements in close-packed-like local arrangements: Mg and Pt centers each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Th centers have 12 neighbors (6 Mg, 6 Pt), with neighbor distances near 3.17–3.20 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 21 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Th-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing among Mg- and Pt-centered polyhedra.
